'''Egg wash''' is often used for coating the top of baked goods, especially pies, to give a shine when baked. It's also used for battering fish and other ingredients for [[Cookbook:Deep Fat Frying|deep frying]].
==Ingredients==
* 1 [[Cookbook:Egg yolk|egg yolk]], [[Cookbook:Egg White|egg white]], or whole [[Cookbook:Egg|egg]]
* 1–2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:Water|water]] or [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]]

==Procedure==

# [[Cookbook:Beating|Beat]] all ingredients together.
# Apply wash as directed by your recipe.
